generation_targeting_policy.instruction: Generation guidance only; it grants neither input nor success authority. Use only candidates in the current target_bindings scope, including the final authorised subset. Use text-only targeting only when current OCR labels or adjacent OCR words can locate the target. If a target is visible in the screenshot but absent from OCR, choose its matching current ID yourself from target_bindings.anonymous_without_ocr_ids; never invent or replace an ID. If no matching allowed candidate is certain, return no steps and explain in errors.

finite_query_limits_scope: Extras only; ASCII word-token spans and geometrically neighbouring runs. Original full labels are retained without the extra-query character cap. Not all runtime substrings or multilingual word runs are generated.

archived_protocol_review_delta.meaning: Prelaunch protocol review only; original draft preserved, no case used it.

preowner_claim_binding: Root writes SHA-bound acknowledgement before owner starts; operator then copies original bytes into new case/window_claim_001.json for the read-only checker.
pre_input_contract_recovery: Refuse already-true proposed goal without input or completion credit; record separate bound rejection; same-budget native remaining-work revision only. Original false-before/known-input/fresh-after completion gates, no-replay and immutable final remain.
historical_fixed_polarity_guidance_scope: Only generation/repair wording; original validation, schema, guards and all other production AST identical. Justified nonempty forbid remains allowed.
historical_model_only_change_scope: Official local model switch only; all276 source/config/test pins, prompts, guards, budgets and callers unchanged. No training or inference during freeze.
failed_contract_feedback_scope: Original native contract plus its own verifier mismatch literals only; null unknown. No raw observation/context or completion rewrite; exact independent source binding and stable wire order.

recovery_schema_scope.allowed_strings: Exactly base, base+target-conflict, base+unresolved-text, base+both in producer order; arbitrary prose still rejected.

role_routing_scope: Optional CLI/API text-model override; request image presence chooses role. Same shared budgets. Original prompts, goal/condition generation, input and credit guards unchanged. Perception source is byte-identical. Independent original HTTP model identity checks are stronger.
intent_generation_scope: Generic explicit caller operation verbs, causal persistence order and minimal justified checkpoint guidance only. All executable AST outside the prompt and other282 pins unchanged. Native efficacy unqualified.

additional_reviewed_scope: Original expected-literal complement of own complete missing list, else null; no raw screen or completion credit. Independent exact shape recomputation. Fixed generic remaining-operation grouping hint; no local goal or condition rewrite.
Fixed repeated-objective generation hint and finite typed category, v4 exact protocol hash metadata. No model data enters system hint.
Original before-true rejection precedence restored; original test unchanged and must pass. Original feedback tests extend exact expected shape only;9 extra negative/complement tests added.
Existing repair-policy SDK test updates exact expected v4 metadata only, with all other AST identical.
failed_plan_repair_scope.meaning: Exact failed/rejected signature enters existing bounded repair loop before any input. Outer failed-signature guard, action/credit/verification, cancellation and budgets retained. Auditor reconstructs failed signatures from original outcomes; recomputes typed rejection and full wire history. Hint removed on other errors. No local plan/condition authoring or acceptance transfer. Saved native diagnostics and fresh GUI cases remain required.

quoted_target_scope.scope: Narrow syntactic quoted target versus readable native target witness. Existing text/ID guards, stale-frame rules, primitive actions, semantic plan/condition parsing, completion credit, budgets and prompts unchanged. quoted_ocr_uncertainty_scope.meaning: Generic uncertainty allowance only for an absent ASCII alphabetic name of length4..160 one character edit from the already chosen readable witness. No exact named alternative may exist elsewhere; exact competing labels, dissimilar/short/numeric names still refuse. No target replacement, OCR rewrite, fuzzy target search or success credit; all original ID/text, fresh-frame, region, budget and task predicate guards unchanged. Counterfactual saved records only, no GUI/model calls or live acceptance.

quoted_recovery_combination_scope.meaning: Use previously retained finite consistency feedback for the new strict quoted-target conflict together with the separately tested OCR-uncertainty adapter. The earlier extra hint alone did not pass its native probe because the old strict adapter refused OCR BELA; that failed experiment remains failed. Transient011 now demonstrates repeated wrong ALPHA targets without any conflict-specific feedback. No local target search/replacement, action dispatch, task predicates, budgets, base prompts or completion credit changed. Only the fixed recovery string and its exact schema/auditor whitelist gain the already-retained text. All native live cases must be new; no acceptance transfers.

long_label_ocr_scope.meaning: Keep one-edit uncertainty for absent4..9-letter ASCII labels; permit at most2edits only when both normalized label lengths are at least10. Whitespace-only differences also remain uncertain. Exact competing readable literal elsewhere still refuses. Original selected native target/ID/coordinates, task predicates, budgets and dispatch unchanged; no fuzzy search or target replacement. Similar real names remain a limitation. Both new native cases required; saved replay is not acceptance.

predicate_content_boundary_scope.meaning: Only fixed initial planning guidance distinguishes caller-final visible evidence from content to compose. Local save/commit does not authorize a new message/title/description operation. No application label/parameter or target sequence injected; original caller, reply parser, message refusal, actions, predicates and all budgets unchanged. Two actual offline tests retain native unsupported-message refusal and require a genuinely revised native reply before execution. Offline success is not live efficacy.

message_refusal_explanation_scope.meaning: Only existing _no_messages ValueError wording clarified: same regex/branch now explicitly includes local message-content composition and distinguishes verification text. No new accepted input or refused input, schema field, caller intent, native plan rewrite, task predicate, target, action, budget, model, protocol or prompt changed. Existing error prefix retained. One extra assertion in an existing end-to-end refusal test checks the message reaches native repair context. Offline checks do not establish native effectiveness.

unsupported_message_repair_scope.meaning: The existing message guard raises a private ValueError subclass with unchanged regex, branch and wording. Only a real Pydantic nested exception of that type selects unsupported_message repair. That retry omits the archived rejected assistant reply, keeps unchanged caller and bounded constraint feedback, and adds a fixed content-versus-verification hint. No new plan is authored locally. Other repair histories and their finite hints remain unchanged, hint is removed after another error type. Independent auditor recomputes category from the original native reply, validates exact policy/messages, rejects assistant reinsertion. Protocol repair policy explicitly versionedv5; model, initial semantic prompt, all task predicates, targets, actions and shared budgets unchanged. Repeated invalid replies and native nonready outcomes still stop with no input. Offline success is not native efficacy.

premature_caller_final_scope.meaning: Only an exact whole immutable caller expect_text/forbid_text conjunction (casefolded literal tuples with order ignored) is refused on a nonlast native goal while later objectives remain. The existing typed duplicate-condition rejection and finite repair feedback are used; only a new native reply can revise the plan. No caption vocabulary, fixed phase sequence, pool-specific cardinality or forced two-goal skeleton is introduced. Caller literals, actions, completion verifier, shared budgets and model remain unchanged. Does not detect every semantic mismatch: partial/superset conditions and operation meanings still need original event/pixel review. Four added checks cover order/case variants and native repair before execution. Saved transient020 accepted compilation now rejects before any before-frame use; no GUI/model replay or old result reclassification.

candidate_visual_details_scope.meaning: Optional visual_candidate_details is false by default and explicitly enabled by the Week6 role-model configuration. Current non-message action context selects anonymous_without_ocr contours by geometry only:96x24minimum,8regions/1Mtotalpixels,reading order; no goal/target word or native reply selects a crop. Original screenshot remains first, original pixels/current IDs/bounds/SHA are logged; no OCR, painting, coordinate-space change or extra model dispatch. Empty region set retains prior format. Nonempty detail requests use a compact canonical-current-ID generation schema; secondary target aliases cannot select another target. This profile does not claim label/ID semantic agreement: original runtime consistency/freshness/scope and task-verification guards are unchanged. Independent auditor rebuilds crop selection and hashes from the actual scoped snapshot/pixels. SDK tests inspect actual encoded image bytes in one HTTP request and wrong-readable-ID refusal before any input. Caller semantic protocol,repairv5,whole-final guard,budgets,model and OCR profile unchanged. Saved development positive is not live acceptance or a heldout accuracy measurement. No old perception timing is attributed to the added vision attachments; actual task wall time includes their overhead.
candidate_visual_details_scope.limitations: Only large current anonymous contours receive details, subject to count/pixel limits. Detection/OCR may omit controls, native model may still select incorrectly; unchanged guard and actual event/pixel review remain necessary.

compact_text_anchor_scope.meaning: Only compact original-pixel-detail generation changes. Every point action still requires a canonical current candidate ID and forbids secondary targeting aliases. A native nonblank target_text is now required except when the model selects an original anonymous_without_ocr candidate, for which null/empty remains allowed. Native text permits the existing fresh-observation text relocation; no stale-ID guard, runtime code, OCR, model, semantic contract, repairv5 or global budget changed. No native reply, label or ID is filled or replaced locally. Detailed image selection/bytes and the default-disabled feature remain unchanged. Versionv4 identifies the compact schema. Related tests cover null/empty/whitespace readable-ID rejection and actual native-text relocation against fresh IDs/moved geometry without mutating the PlanStep. Saved production probes on two ended development frames are one request each, not live acceptance or heldout accuracy.
compact_text_anchor_scope.limitations: Model can still choose wrong or ambiguous targets; only large anonymous contours receive bounded crops. Original per-stage/event/pixel acceptance and all runtime guards remain necessary.

operation_outcome_guidance_scope.meaning: Only the semantic generation system prompt receives leading generic outcome-sufficiency guidance. A goal instruction naming A then B cannot be credited by conditions establishing only A or availability of B. The model is asked to separate independently distinguishable operations or explicitly group all operations sharing an outcome. No application-specific phase list, operation parser, goal rewrite, predicate whitelist, verifier, action prompt, model, OCR or budget change. Existing guards and independent business-operation review remain required; guidance is not a semantic proof or guarantee.
operation_outcome_guidance_scope.limits: A native proposal can still be wrong. Fixed literals do not prove arbitrary business meaning; saved pixels, distinct application events and each original instruction must be reviewed after real execution.

execution_failure_guidance_scope.meaning: Only generic failed-contract generation guidance changes. Unmet immutable caller final predicates are distinguished from unjustified model-invented captions. The model is told to preserve verified work and plan all remaining operations, including caller-authorized retry; no fabricated captions, forced ready, rewritten native reply, operation parser, verifier or guard relaxation. Model, OCR, budgets and runtime remain unchanged.
execution_failure_guidance_scope.limits: Generation guidance is not universal semantic proof. Fresh same-source normal and recovery cases, operation review, full regression and artifact review remain required.
